x: No doubt most of you were watching on TV and saw the way he ate up the ground in the last 30 metres of the 100m to come through to 3rd place behind Elliot Bunney and Havas of Hungary, in another Club Junior Record, after a cautious start because of a still tender hamstring.

John, Elliott Bunney, Mike McFarlane and Linford Christie set a new UK record of 38.28 secs to finish 1/10 sec. behind the USSR. Things didn't go so well for John in the 100m, a late tackle by an aspiring Portugese rugby player meant he failed to get beyond the 1st round of the 100m.
A storming third leg by Graham Adams had brought us into third spot but in a scramble for the line Mike was gobbled up by three other teams including a fast moving Elliott Bunney.
